summary: Provides financial assistance to eligible rural households for construction of a pucca house.
benefits: Central assistance for house construction, plus convergence support (toilet, electricity, LPG connection) with other government schemes.
eligibility: Houseless or households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural areas
Identified through the Socio-Economic Caste Census / Awaas+ survey
application_steps: Verify inclusion in the Awaas+ / PMAY-G beneficiary list
Construction tracked via the geo-tagged mobile app
